cost_basis.method: Multiply the mean by the maximum call count and add 25 percent.
cost_basis.source: The larger recent mean call cost from Phase 8c4b calibration r1 or the prior retained basis.

repair_policy.eligible: Every available initial parse or musical-contract failure, including a named sentinel.
repair_policy.feedback: Return only the structured parse or failed-check diagnostic.
repair_policy.primary_result: Initial musical success only. A repair never replaces an initial result.
repair_policy.unavailable_or_failed: Do not repair and do not add to a scored denominator.

stopping_rule: Return proceed-development only when every decision family is inside the exact-object band on at least two providers and every unique initial result is scored. Otherwise return repair-measurement. Calibration cannot select a format.
